results.title: Soccer-No sleep for Pochettino as new era at Man United begins
results.description: MANCHESTER, England, Nov 19 (Reuters) - Mauricio Pochettino could be forgiven for taking some time to recover from jetlag before beginning his new job as Manchester United manager, but the Argentine knows there is little time for settling in at the struggling Premier League club.

results.title: Video: Sunny, warm stretch continues into the weekend
results.description: Cool nights and very mild afternoons for this time of year continues as we approach the weekend. Kevin Skarupa is tracking our next chances ahead of next week.

results.title: We that needed win says Raiders coach
results.description: Romford Raiders head coach Sean Easton admitted his side "needed" their National League win over Solway IHC on Sunday.
